name: Computer Use
description: Observe and operate desktop or browser interfaces when dedicated tools cannot complete the request or visual verification is required.
progressive_guidance:
Use the shortest sufficient path: continue in a relevant existing window; launch only when necessary, using the owner’s chosen app or configured preference. Do not switch apps just for a richer control backend. Respect the configured interaction mode; background is the default, visible interaction is appropriate when the owner asks to watch.
Teaching, explaining, translating, summarizing, and inspecting are read-only unless a change is requested. Analyze supplied images first; use tools only for missing evidence, and do not edit fields to understand them. Survey long pages once in one direction with page-sized scrolls and capture_after=true. Reuse captures; stop at the end, repeated content, or sufficient evidence, and state remaining uncertainty.
Open a dropdown only for needed, unseen choices. Try once from observed evidence; retry once only if the failure mode changes, then explain the obstacle.
